title: unit-splitter output units.json
description: OUTPUT of the unit-splitter: <out>/units.json next to host.js, units/<name>.js and ids.json (packages/unit-splitter/src/build.js). Describes which module ids belong to the host and to each unit. Copied unchanged into the ota-build build dir (build.json.unitsMap points at it) and used as the 'base' of later patch builds. NAME CLASH WARNING: not the input units.config.json (units.config.schema.json) and not the governance units.json of the ota-deployments repo (ota-units-governance.schema.json). Builds made before the cycles/checks/publicApi fields existed lack them and do not validate. NOT expressible: moduleIds of host and units are disjoint; paths values name existing units; entryId is in the unit's moduleIds.

platform.description: Metro platform the graph was built for.

idBits.description: Width in bits of the path-hash module ids (default 48; ids must stay below 2^53 to be exact JS numbers).

moduleIds.description: Ids of all host-owned modules, ascending.

packages.description: npm packages (name -> version) present in the host bundle.

assets.description: Image assets referenced by host modules (files must exist in the binary).

host.description: The host bundle (host.js): Metro runtime + polyfills + host-owned modules.

paths.description: entryModuleId (as string) -> unit name: what the host's compiled import() passes to asyncRequire.

units.description: Per-unit bundle description keyed by unit name.

entryId.description: Module id of the unit entry module.

entryPath.description: Project-relative path key of the unit entry module.

moduleIds.description: Ids of all modules owned by the unit, ascending.

packages.description: npm packages seen in the unit (patch mode: new pure-JS packages bundled into it).

assets.description: Image assets referenced by the unit's modules.

cycles.description: Dependency cycles per owner ("host" = first-party host code, or a unit name): the base a later patch build is compared against (checks.cycles ratchet).

signature.description: sha256 hex of the sorted module keys of the strongly connected component.

modules.description: Project-relative keys of the modules in the cycle.

async.description: Present (true) when the cycle needs an import() edge: informational only.

checks.description: Per-check summary keyed by rule id (e.g. "cycles", "single-import-site", "dynamic-require", "host-exports", "public-api", "public-deep-import"). Extra counters vary per check and are allowed.

severity.description: Effective severity of the check in this build.

publicApi.description: Runtime export surface of each public (host-owned) package at this build (config checks.publicPackages); compared with the committed snapshot file.

default.description: Whether the entry has a default export.

opaque.description: Present when the entry could not be statically analyzed; the reason.

sha256.description: Bare 64-hex sha256 of the asset file (no "sha256:" prefix, unlike OTA hashes).
